# Octopye Service Context

Octopye Digital Designs is a web design and web engineering business focused on HTML, CSS and JavaScript websites for small businesses. App design is the second core service. SEO, hosting, forms, tracking and care are supporting services that make the website or app work better.

Primary pages:
- Home: https://octopye.com/
- Services: https://octopye.com/services
- Packages: https://octopye.com/packages
- Tools, audit and estimate: https://octopye.com/estimate
- Organic Google reach plan: https://octopye.com/organic-google-reach
- Industries: https://octopye.com/industries
- Projects: https://octopye.com/projects
- Booking: https://octopye.com/booking

Primary offers:
- Website audit tools and guided instant estimator: a GitHub Pages-compatible question-led estimator plus best-effort public PageSpeed checks for HTML, WordPress, React/SPA, ecommerce, builder and static websites. Automatic scans can be blocked by target sites; the estimator still works without backend code.
- Organic Google reach plan: a no-ads plan for Search Console setup, sitemap submission, crawlable internal links, Google Business Profile signals where eligible, real reviews, client backlinks, proof-led case studies and weekly content improvement.
- Free website conversion audit: review of messaging, page structure, SEO basics, calls to action, and lead capture.
- HTML/CSS/JS landing page design: from GBP 249 setup.
- Static small business website: from GBP 599 setup.
- App design prototype: from GBP 799.
- Website redesign sprint: from GBP 399.
- SEO Growth Plan: from GBP 149/month.

Organic and local reach notes:
- Local reach for a web design business should be built through legitimate Google Business Profile information, real reviews, service descriptions, project photos, client mentions and partner backlinks.
- Octopye should avoid fake location pages because web design is not limited to physical service areas.
- Search Console should be used after launch to submit https://octopye.com/sitemap.xml, inspect key URLs, request indexing and improve pages that receive impressions but low clicks.
- The most important internal targets are the home page, web design page, small business websites page, packages page, estimator/auditor, projects page, industries hub and organic Google reach page.
